notes: Step 1 parts were correct and are unchanged. The built-in LED on pin 13 is on the Uno, so there is no external LED or resistor, and the tutorial's parts list has none.

Breadboard holes are read from the image. The potentiometer straddles the centre channel. Its two outer legs are at columns 10 and 12 in the bottom half, and its wiper leg is at column 11 in the top half.
The black wire goes to the second GND pin of the power header, which I mapped to GND.2. Both GND pins are the same net, so the choice does not change the circuit.
The potentiometer's outer legs are interchangeable. GND goes to the column with the black wire and VCC to the column with the red wire (5V). The wiper (SIG) goes to the yellow wire to A0.
The yellow wire's end sits in the top half at column 11, in the same strip as the wiper leg. I placed the wiper at 11t.f and the wire end at 11t.g.
